description.narrative: The Global Blue Peace Financing (BPF) Program is a strategic initiative designed to promote sustainable and cooperative management of water resources across borders and sectors. It addresses the limitations of the current financial ecosystem, which often treats water-related investments in a fragmented and sectoral manner. The program seeks to unlock public and private capital to improve equitable access to water-related services while advancing integrated water resources management (IWRM), transboundary cooperation, and peacebuilding. By supporting local and regional non-sovereign entities, the program enhances their access to financing and strengthens their institutional, legal, and policy frameworks. It also fosters partnerships with financial stakeholders to facilitate capital flow to water initiatives and establishes standards and measurement frameworks to improve financing efficiency and impact. Through the development and implementation of innovative financing mechanisms, the BPF Program aims to create a new market for sustainable finance and scale successful models globally for greater resilience and cooperation in water governance.
